guard.rule: A pull pair is skipped for one side (pitcher ratings / hitter ratings) when the median shift of a gap-tracked current rating or its potential reaches 2 points across that side's players, or when 20% of them lose points on one current rating.

age_curves.underlying_note: Band table is the user's OOTP 26 mapping (approximate). Measured on this archive: 20 is read at 115.5 (players sit near the top of the floor band); fielding, running, stamina, hold and pitch ratings are NOT converted (no narrowing above 55 for them) and stay in display steps. Guard readings (median shift, down share) are 20-80 display points.
age_curves.note: Average rating GAIN PER YEAR OF AGE: batting and pitching ratings in OOTP's internal 1-600 points (the 20-80 display is an uneven banding of them; each rating is read inside its band before the difference is taken; band edges approximate), fielding/running in 20-80 display steps. How much a player at this age gains before he ages up, MLB/minors only, exposure-weighted across 1 consecutive pull pairs (0.02 game-years; 0 zero-time pairs skipped as scout churn). A short archive is still directional. It sharpens automatically as game-years accumulate.

WE.note: Work ethic from the current pull. Personality is nearly static in OOTP, so the current value stands in for the whole archive.

WAA.label: Projected value among players his age
WAA.note: Rank of his CURRENT projected WAA (engine projection of the ratings in the older pull of each pair, neutral park) among org players of the same integer age and the same side: hitters with hitters, pitchers with pitchers. Age groups under 8 players are left out. Own side only: hitter ratings from position players, pitcher ratings from pitchers. Players without an org at the start of the pull pair are left out, and so are players of a foreign-league club (NPB / KBO). A personality record is not needed.

LDR.label: Leaders on his team
LDR.note: Teammates with High leadership, himself excluded. Team and leadership are read from the older pull of each pair, as that pull's own file recorded them: same org, same level and same club id. The first pull of each league (sheet era) has no club id and no personality; it uses org + level and the current leadership value. Free agents, the amateur pool, the international complex and unassigned reserves have no team and are left out. Own side only: hitter ratings from position players, pitcher ratings from pitchers. Players without an org at the start of the pull pair are left out, and so are players of a foreign-league club (NPB / KBO). A personality record is not needed.

NEG.label: Low-leadership teammates
NEG.note: Teammates with Low leadership, himself excluded. Team and leadership are read from the older pull of each pair, as that pull's own file recorded them: same org, same level and same club id. The first pull of each league (sheet era) has no club id and no personality; it uses org + level and the current leadership value. Free agents, the amateur pool, the international complex and unassigned reserves have no team and are left out. Own side only: hitter ratings from position players, pitcher ratings from pitchers. Players without an org at the start of the pull pair are left out, and so are players of a foreign-league club (NPB / KBO). A personality record is not needed.
